title.zh: 缺一个格子的 Snaky 是一手威胁
title.en: A Snaky missing one cell is a one-move threat

given.zh: S 本身包含一个 Snaky；Maker 已拥有 S ∖ {p}，Breaker 尚未占据 S 中任何格子。
given.en: S contains a Snaky, Maker owns S ∖ {p}, and Breaker occupies no cell of S.

claim.zh: Threat(HasSnaky,S ∖ {p},S,1) 成立，因而六个基础行都有真正的博弈含义。
claim.en: Threat(HasSnaky,S ∖ {p},S,1) holds, giving all six base rows a game-theoretic meaning.

statement.en: If p∈M, then S⊆M because S∖{p}⊆M.

reason.zh: S 中等于 p 的点由本分支给出，其余点由威胁的所需点条件给出；此时目标图形已经出现。
reason.en: The branch assumption supplies p and the requirement supplies every other cell of S, so the target shape is already present.

statement.zh: p∉M 且 p∈S ⇒ p∉B，Maker 可落 p，随后 S⊆M∪{p}。
statement.en: If p∉M and p∈S, then p∉B; Maker may claim p and obtain S⊆M∪{p}.

reason.zh: H=S 与 B 不交保证这个缺失格未被对手占据；若 p 根本不在 S 中，S∖{p}=S 已使目标成立。
reason.en: Disjointness of H=S from B makes the missing cell legal. If p is not in S at all, S∖{p}=S already gives the goal.

statement.zh: HasSnaky(M′) 在 M′ 扩大时保持，故可得到精确的一手 Winning。
statement.en: HasSnaky(M′) persists when M′ grows, giving the required one-move Winning statement.

reason.zh: 目标已出现时可选择新空格补足这一步；目标尚缺 p 时，落 p 后的任意合法回复都不改变 Maker 已拥有的 S。
reason.en: If the goal already holds, a fresh legal cell pads the move. Otherwise claiming p completes S, and any legal reply leaves Maker’s set intact.

title.zh: 对手一手不能同时阻断全部分支
title.en: One reply cannot block every branch

given.zh: 每个 child 都是 ≤n 手威胁；各 Aᵢ ⊆ A∪{p}、Hᵢ ⊆ H，且 p∈H、⋂Hᵢ ⊆ A∪{p}。假设 A⊆M、H∩B=∅。
given.en: Each child is a threat of at most n moves, with Aᵢ ⊆ A∪{p}, Hᵢ ⊆ H, p∈H and ⋂Hᵢ ⊆ A∪{p}. Assume A⊆M and H∩B=∅.

claim.zh: 这些 child 合成一个 n+1 手威胁。
claim.en: The children combine into a threat of n+1 moves.

statement.en: If p∉M, then p∉M∪B, so claiming p is legal.

reason.zh: p∈H 而 H∩B=∅ 排除 p∈B；落子后所有 Aᵢ⊆A∪{p}⊆M∪{p} 都已被 Maker 满足。
reason.en: p∈H and H∩B=∅ exclude p∈B. After the move, Aᵢ⊆A∪{p}⊆M∪{p} satisfies every child requirement.

statement.en: A legal reply b∉M∪{p} gives b∉A∪{p}, hence some i has b∉Hᵢ.

reason.zh: 若 b 属于所有 Hᵢ，交集条件会把它放进 A∪{p}，与合法性矛盾。这里选择的 child 可以随对手回复而改变。
reason.en: If b belonged to every Hᵢ, the intersection condition would place it in A∪{p}, contradicting legality. The chosen child may depend on the reply.

statement.zh: Hᵢ∩(B∪{b})=∅，因此该 child 在剩余至多 n 手内完成。
statement.en: Hᵢ∩(B∪{b})=∅, so the selected child succeeds in at most n further moves.

reason.zh: 原先 Hᵢ⊆H 已排除旧 B，上一行又排除新点 b；结合已满足的 Aᵢ，就能应用 child 的 Threat。
reason.en: The inclusion Hᵢ⊆H excludes the old B, and the previous line excludes b. Together with Aᵢ, these are exactly the selected Threat’s hypotheses.

statement.zh: 若 p∈M，直接取任一 child，再把其高度补到 n+1。
statement.en: If p∈M, choose any child and pad its height to n+1.

reason.zh: 此时 Aᵢ 已在 M 中，包络也未受阻；非空 child 列表提供可选分支，目标单调性允许使用 winning_mono_time。
reason.en: All Aᵢ are already owned and their envelopes unblocked. The nonempty list supplies a child, and monotonicity permits winning_mono_time.

title.zh: 按 child 索引严格递减，把整张表解释为策略
title.en: Interpret the whole table by descending child indices

given.zh: qTableValid 保证每项非空且 child < 当前行号；六个基础行已是威胁，旋转平移保持 HasSnaky。
given.en: qTableValid gives nonempty entries with child indices below the current row; base rows are threats, and rotations and translations preserve HasSnaky.

claim.zh: 对全部 i<616，Threat(qGoal,(qr i).A,(qr i).H,(qr i).height) 成立。
claim.en: For every i<616, Threat(qGoal,(qr i).A,(qr i).H,(qr i).height) holds.

statement.zh: i<6：第 i 行是平移后的 S∖{p}，高度为 1。
statement.en: For i<6, row i is a translated S∖{p}, with height one.

reason.zh: 基础行把 Snaky 的六个可能缺口逐一移到原点；前面的叶威胁因此覆盖所有基础索引。
reason.en: The base rows translate each of Snaky’s six possible missing cells to the origin. The leaf-threat argument covers every base index.

statement.zh: i≥6：每项 child j<i，先得到 Threat(qGoal,Aⱼ,Hⱼ,hⱼ)。
statement.en: For i≥6, every child j<i already has Threat(qGoal,Aⱼ,Hⱼ,hⱼ).

reason.zh: 强归纳允许直接使用所有较小索引的结论；旋转平移是格点双射，连同 HasSnaky 的图形见证一起搬运该威胁。
reason.en: Strong induction supplies all smaller indices. Rotate and translate each threat along a cell bijection, transporting its HasSnaky witness as well.

statement.zh: 把已放置 child 代入 fork：父高度 1+max hⱼ，得到第 i 行的 Threat。
statement.en: Fork the placed children at height 1+max hⱼ to obtain the Threat for row i.

reason.zh: fork 的 A、H 定义正好保证上一阶段所需的包含与交集条件；因此归纳从六个叶行扩展到全部 i<616。
reason.en: The fork definitions of A and H supply the required containments and intersection condition. This extends the six leaf cases to every i<616.

title.zh: 把开局分支合成空棋盘的 35 手必胜性
title.en: Combine the opening branches into a 35-move win from empty

given.zh: 12 个高度 ≤33 的分支先组成 34 手的 escape 威胁；平移后它只要求 Maker 已占原点。它与关键行的旋转平移共组成 24 个根分支。
given.en: Twelve branches of height ≤33 first form a 34-move escape threat; after translation it requires only the origin. Together with placements of the distinguished rows, it forms 24 root branches.

claim.zh: 根分支全部满足 Aᵢ ⊆ {o}、heightᵢ ≤34、⋂Hᵢ ⊆ {o}，所以 Winning(qGoal,35,∅,∅)。
claim.en: Every root branch has Aᵢ ⊆ {o} and heightᵢ ≤34, while ⋂Hᵢ ⊆ {o}; hence Winning(qGoal,35,∅,∅).

statement.zh: 12 个 child 的高度≤33 ⇒ escape 的高度为 34，所需点为 {(0,−1)}。
statement.en: Twelve children of height≤33 yield an escape threat of height 34 requiring {(0,−1)}.

reason.zh: 这些 child 的 A 都在 {(0,−1),o} 内，共同 H 也只可能落在这两个点；在 o 分叉后从所需集删去 o。
reason.en: The child requirements and common envelope lie in {(0,−1),o}. Forking at o removes o from the parent requirement.

statement.zh: 将 escape 平移 (0,1)，其所需点变成 {o}。
statement.en: Translate escape by (0,1), turning its required set into {o}.

reason.zh: (0,−1)+(0,1)=o；平移保持威胁和高度，所以它可以和关键行的其他放置一起作为根分支。
reason.en: (0,−1)+(0,1)=o. Translation preserves the threat and its height, allowing it to join the placed distinguished rows as a root branch.

statement.en: The 24 root children satisfy Aᵢ⊆{o}, hᵢ≤34 and ⋂Hᵢ⊆{o}.

reason.zh: 前两项由 qroot_A_bound、qroot_child_height 逐项核对；qroot_common_bound 排除每个原点外的共同包络点。
reason.en: qroot_A_bound and qroot_child_height verify the first two clauses; qroot_common_bound excludes all non-origin common-envelope cells.

statement.zh: Maker 首手取 o ⇒ 任意合法回复后仍有一个 child，故 1+34=35。
statement.en: Maker opens at o; some child survives every legal reply, giving 1+34=35.

reason.zh: 对手不能回复 o，因而不能同时落入全部根包络。分叉定理得到所需点为空的 35 手威胁，在空棋盘上即可直接使用。
reason.en: The reply cannot be o and therefore cannot belong to every root envelope. The fork theorem yields a 35-move threat with no required cells, applicable from the empty board.

title.zh: 提取策略，并跟踪每一步的合法状态
title.en: Extract the policy and track legal states

given.zh: Winning(HasSnaky,35,∅,∅) 已证。对手 β 只需在最后一手之前满足 LegalRepliesBeforeFinal。
given.en: Winning(HasSnaky,35,∅,∅) is established. The opponent β satisfies LegalRepliesBeforeFinal, which requires legality only before the final Maker move.

claim.zh: 存在始终不落入 M∪B 的 σ；任意这样的 β 都使 Maker 第35手后包含 Snaky、恰有35子，且与 Breaker 的前34子不交。每个 k<35 的中间状态双方不交，Breaker 恰有 k 子。
claim.en: There is a σ that always avoids M∪B. For every such β, Maker has a Snaky and exactly 35 cells after move 35, disjoint from Breaker’s first 34 cells. At every k<35 the two sets are disjoint and Breaker has exactly k cells.

statement.zh: σ(n,M,B) 取 Winning 的合法首手；若无见证，则取 M∪B 外的新格。
statement.en: σ(n,M,B) chooses a legal first move from Winning, or a fresh cell outside M∪B when no witness exists.

reason.zh: 棋盘 ℤ² 无限而 M∪B 有限，因此后备落点始终存在。这让 σ 在每个输入局面都有定义并始终合法。
reason.en: The board ℤ² is infinite and M∪B finite, so the fallback always exists. Thus σ is defined and legal on every input state.

reason.zh: k=0 来自空棋盘结论；对 k≤33，合法的 βₖ 使 winningPolicy_step 把剩余手数减一。每次双方插入新格，同时保持不交。
reason.en: The k=0 case is the empty-board result. For k≤33, legal βₖ lets winningPolicy_step reduce the remaining moves by one, while fresh insertions preserve disjointness.

statement.zh: k=34 时剩余 1 手；第 35 个 Maker 落点后，HasSnaky(M₃₅)。
statement.en: At k=34 one move remains; after Maker’s 35th move, HasSnaky(M₃₅) holds.

reason.zh: 一手 Winning 的结论只取决于插入 Maker 落点后的集合。证明选一个辅助合法回复来读取该结论，不要求实际的 β₃₄ 合法。
reason.en: The one-move Winning conclusion depends only on Maker’s updated set. The proof uses an auxiliary fresh legal reply to read it, without assuming legality of the actual β₃₄.

statement.en: |M₃₅|=35 and M₃₅∩B₃₄=∅; for k<35, |Bₖ|=k and Mₖ∩Bₖ=∅.

reason.zh: Maker 总选新格，故每次基数加一；前 34 次合法回复同理。最后一次 Maker 只需避开已经存在的 B₃₄。
reason.en: Every Maker move is fresh, increasing its cardinality by one; the first 34 legal replies do likewise. The final Maker move avoids the already existing B₃₄.
